item.title: Turn a 2015 Laptop into a Fast Machine: SSD + RAM Upgrade Guide
item.description: A laptop with an i5-5200U and 4 GB RAM is not slow because the CPU is old — it is slow because it is waiting for a 5400 rpm hard drive and swapping to disk. Replacing those two parts costs less than a new laptop and gives 10× the responsiveness.
